# AI Lab Consulting

> AI Lab Consulting helps banks, credit unions, insurers and fintechs put AI agents into production with the approvals and records that examiners and auditors expect.

## Services

- [AI governance assessment](https://ailabconsulting.com/#assessment): A fixed-scope review of the AI agents you run. You get the gaps against SR 11-7, SOX, DORA and the EU AI Act and a ranked plan to close them.
- [Approval and audit architecture](https://ailabconsulting.com/#approval-and-audit): Permissions, per-action approvals and a decision record for each agent, enforced where the action runs.
- [Compliant AI-assisted engineering](https://ailabconsulting.com/#ai-assisted-engineering): Pipeline and review rules that let engineers use AI coding tools and keep the change-control evidence SOX, PCI DSS and DORA require.
- [Fractional AI governance lead](https://ailabconsulting.com/#fractional-lead): Part-time senior leadership for AI policy, architecture review and board reporting.

## How engagements work

Engagements start with a fixed-scope assessment of your agents and controls. If you continue, we build the controls with your team on one workflow first, then extend them and hand over the documentation and evidence. You can stop after any step.

## About

A small senior team with backgrounds in enterprise architecture and compliance at regulated financial firms, based in Laguna Beach, California. We design and build controls; legal interpretation and attestation stay with the client's compliance team and auditors.
